requirements.quote: 4.2.1. Sub-requirement 1: The enclosure must be of SLS prototype
requirements.text: The enclosure must be an SLS prototype.

requirements.quote: 4.2.2. Sub-requirement 2: The enclosure material type must be of minimum quality SLS Polyamide (e.g., Nylon 11 powder)
requirements.text: The enclosure material must be SLS Polyamide, such as Nylon 11 powder.

requirements.quote: 4.2.3. Sub-requirement 3: The device enclosure must be printed according to the provided STEP files and their respective quantities per Device:
requirements.text: The enclosure must be printed as per provided STEP files and specified quantities.

requirements.quote: i. 1 x Body Fingerprint Scanner Button
requirements.text: 1 Body Fingerprint Scanner Button is required.

requirements.quote: ii. 1 x Body Fingerprint Scanner Face
requirements.text: 1 Body Fingerprint Scanner Face is required.

requirements.quote: iii. 1 x Body Fingerprint Scanner Top
requirements.text: 1 Body Fingerprint Scanner Top is required.

requirements.quote: 4.2.4. Sub-requirement 4: The enclosure must have a quality assurance on the printed 3D structures
requirements.text: The enclosure must undergo quality assurance for the printed 3D structures.

requirements.quote: 4.2.5. Sub-requirements 5: Device enclosure complexity: As per supplied enclosure specification subjected to Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) – The briefing session will be used to present Device enclosure designs. The dimensions and 3D enclosure files will be shared to attendees during the briefing session.
requirements.text: The enclosure complexity must follow specifications under NDA, with details shared in a briefing session.

requirements.quote: 4.2.6. Sub-requirement 6: The enclosure color must be black.
requirements.text: The enclosure color must be black.

requirements.quote: 4.3.1. Sub-requirement 1: Assemble all the Device sub-modules (requirement 4.1, requirement 4.2 and requirement 4.4) inside the enclosure (requirement 4.3) to have a fully assembled Fingerprint Recognition Device – The briefing session will be used to present the technical specifications of the PCB board circuits, and the system integration procedure for the Device.
requirements.text: Assemble all sub-modules into the enclosure to create a fully assembled device, with details provided in a briefing session.
The assembly must meet IPC Class II specifications.
